name: Herefordshire
description: Herefordshire is a predominantly rural county on the Welsh border, characterised by rolling hills, orchards, farmland and historic villages. Hereford is the principal settlement, and the county is particularly associated with cider production, agriculture and the River Wye.

places.name: Herefordshire
places.description: A rural county on the Welsh border known for cider-making, black-and-white timbered villages, and Hereford Cathedral, home to the Mappa Mundi, a medieval map of the known world.
